summary: Defined single-requirement overflow batching and scoped no-file-map fallback around integration trust checks.

items.title: Oversized single-diff batches are undefined
items.rationale: The spec now distinguishes bounded multi-requirement batches from single-requirement overflow batches whose indivisible diff exceeds the batch limit.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[1].desc, requirements[5].desc, acceptance_criteria[3], acceptance_criteria[4], clarifications[1].a, and tasks[1].acceptance now define the overflow rule.

items.title: No-file-map fallback conflicts with integration artifact trust
items.rationale: The spec now limits no-file-map fallback to phases where trust checks permit it and explicitly preserves integration file-map trust failure before requirement agent calls.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[3].desc, requirements[5].desc, acceptance_criteria[7], acceptance_criteria[8], overview.decisions[5], and tasks[2].acceptance now cover the integration trust path.
